goat_external_xyz.scientific_basis: Isotopic mass does not alter the electronic potential-energy surface; the GOAT/xTB conformer-search coordinates therefore use ordinary H.

downstream_opt_freq.prohibition: Do not append M=... to an external XYZ file and do not use the initial start.xyz geometry for production opt/freq.

official_documentation.title: ORCA 6.1 Manual, 2.2 Input of Coordinates
official_documentation.relevance: External xyzfile syntax and M=... as a non-standard-isotope modifier after an inline atomic coordinate definition.

local_parser_observation: ORCA 6.1.1 ScanXYZ rejected a fifth-column M= token in external start.xyz; the production bundle therefore enforces standard four-column XYZ.
